parameters.pivot_rule: candidate low strictly below all 2 left + 2 right completed-bar lows; entire 5-bar pivot window lies inside latest 24 completed bars including trigger
parameters.break_rule: first physical future tick with price strictly below frozen reference
parameters.new_high_rule: first physical future tick with price strictly above frozen channel high
parameters.no_observation_policy: all Dev4 outcome fields NA when future_tick_count=0
parameters.simultaneous_break_policy: record every reference sharing the first physical break seq in canonical reference order
parameters.continuity_semantics: same contract + same session + no DATA_GAP continuity partition; completed-bar lookback may span consecutive trading days like M3/M4
